final: SELECT mt.Name, AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds) AS rate, AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds) / (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM (SELECT AVG(1.0 * t2.Bytes / t2.Milliseconds) AS rate FROM Track t2 JOIN MediaType mt2 ON mt2.MediaTypeId = t2.MediaTypeId WHERE t2.Bytes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY mt2.MediaTypeId)) AS rate_over_mean FROM Track t JOIN MediaType mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name
